regions.name: Lantan
regions.summary: Gnomish island nation of inventors and artificers. It sells precision goods and guards its formulae; foreign trade is channelled through a few licensed harbours.
regions.notes: The Lantan hub itself is not in the settlement catalog; Nemesser and Sundrah are surveyed markets inferred from it.

regions.name: Nimbral
regions.summary: Shadow-veiled magocracy of illusionists. Arcane goods and fine wine go out; metal, fuel and grain must come in by sea.
regions.notes: Fort Beluarian and Sambar carry the Nimbral label but sit far from the island; the border report lists them as outside it.

regions.name: Moonshae Isles
regions.summary: Pastoral, druid-guarded island kingdoms. Wool, cheese and salt fish feed the Sword Coast; iron, silk and spice come back in exchange.

regions.name: Sea of Swords
regions.summary: Free-port islands of mercenaries, shipwrights and smugglers. Ships, sailcloth and hired swords go out; grain and produce arrive by sea.

regions.name: Trackless Sea
regions.summary: Northmen raider island. Whale oil, amber and longships go out; grain, fruit and wine must be bought or taken.
